title: 第84章 国强饭店那两口子不好惹
content_zh:
第84章 国强饭店那两口子不好惹-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

林国强站在饭店门口，把刚刚发生那一幕都看在眼里。

赵素梅牵着林静回来，经过他身边的时候，他侧身让了让。

“素梅。”

赵素梅停下来。

林国强看着她，嘴角微微翘了一下。

“干得漂亮。”

赵素梅愣了一下，然后笑了。

那笑容里带着点不好意思，又带着点解气。

“跟谁学的？”

“跟你。”

林国强笑出了声。

他弯下腰，把林静抱起来。

“静静，以后谁再跟你说这种话，你就告诉他，我爸说了，谁敢欺负我，他就掀了谁家桌子。”

林静破涕为笑，搂住他的脖子。

“爸，真的吗？”

“真的。”

事情传得快。

当天晚上，整条街的商户都知道了。

国强饭店的老板娘，挺着大肚子找隔壁布店算账去了。

“听说把那刘婶说得哑口无言。”

“该！让她嘴欠，没事逗人家孩子干啥？”

“以前看赵素梅温温柔柔的，没想到这么硬气。”

“人家那是护犊子，平时不惹事，惹急了也不好欺负。”

“国强饭店那两口子，都不好惹。

当家的有本事，老板娘也不是软柿子。”

第二天，刘婶看见赵素梅，老远就笑着打招呼。

赵素梅也笑着应了。

就像什么都没发生过一样。

但整条街的人都记住了。

别惹国强饭店的人。

傍晚，赵志军送货回来，听孙小丽说了下午的事，冲赵素梅竖了个大拇指。

“三姐，你厉害。”

赵素梅抿着嘴笑，低头拨算盘。

林静又恢复了往常的样子，在院子里骑着木马，咯咯笑。

林薇抱着布偶兔子，追在姐姐后面，奶声奶气地喊着“姐姐、姐姐”。

林国强站在后厨门口，看着这一幕。

赵素梅抬起头，正好对上他的目光。

Chapter 84 The couple at Guoqiang Hotel are not easy to mess with - "Reborn in 80, taking my wife and daughter to eat and drink after the separation"

Lin Guoqiang stood at the door of the hotel, watching the scene that just happened.

Zhao Sumei led Lin Jing back, and when she passed by him, he stepped aside and gave way.

"Su Mei."

Zhao Sumei stopped.

Lin Guoqiang looked at her and raised the corners of his mouth slightly.

"Well done."

Zhao Sumei was stunned for a moment, then smiled.

There was a bit of embarrassment in that smile, but also a bit of relief.

"Who did you learn it from?"

"With you."

Lin Guoqiang laughed out loud.

He bent down and picked up Lin Jing.

"Jingjing, if anyone says something like this to you again in the future, tell him or her that my dad said that he will overturn the table of anyone who dares to bully me."

Lin Jing burst into laughter and hugged his neck.

"Dad, is it true?"

"Really."

Things spread quickly.

That night, all the merchants on the street knew about it.

The proprietress of the Guoqiang Hotel went to settle the score with the cloth shop next door.

"I heard that Aunt Liu was left speechless."

"That's right! What's the point of teasing other people's children if she has nothing to say?"

"I used to see Zhao Sumei as gentle and gentle, but I didn't expect her to be so tough."

"He's a little bit protective. He doesn't cause trouble at ordinary times, but he's not easy to bully when he gets into trouble."

"Those two at Guoqiang Hotel are not easy to mess with.

The boss is capable, and the landlady is not a soft persimmon."

The next day, Aunt Liu saw Zhao Sumei and said hello with a smile from afar.

Zhao Sumei also responded with a smile.

It's like nothing happened.

But the whole street remembered it.

Don't mess with the people at Guoqiang Hotel.

In the evening, Zhao Zhijun came back from delivering goods. After listening to Sun Xiaoli talk about what happened in the afternoon, he gave Zhao Sumei a thumbs up.

"Third sister, you are amazing."

Zhao Sumei pursed her lips and smiled, lowering her head to dial in the abacus.

Lin Jing returned to her usual appearance, riding a wooden horse in the yard and giggling.

Lin Wei hugged the stuffed rabbit and chased after her sister, shouting "sister, sister" in a sweet voice.

Lin Guoqiang stood at the door of the kitchen, watching this scene.

Zhao Sumei raised her head and met his gaze.
